title: USASOC CY2026 C-sUAS Open Call
agency: U.S. Army Special Operations Command (via SOFWERX/Vulcan)
type: Open call, quad-chart submission via Vulcan-SOF; TRL 4–7
fit_note: The four listed areas are handheld or body-worn sensors, handheld RF detect/defeat, GNSS denial/spoofing, and man-packable (<50 lb) expeditionary fixed sites with detection, and everything must minimize the user's electromagnetic signature. A UM pitch would frame the canister and EO/IR as a man-packable expeditionary site with passive detection plus a capture effector. The onboard active radar works against the low-EM-signature requirement, so lead with EO/IR. TRL 4–7 accepts a prototype.
verify: Confirm on Vulcan-SOF before submitting; listed by BW&Co innovation funding database.

title: xTech|Apex Intercept (Low-Cost Interceptor prize)
agency: Army xTech with Capability Portfolio Executive Defensive Fires
amount: $8M pool; up to 30 finalists ($25K each), up to 18 winners ($7.25M)
fit_note: Aimed at rocket motor, seeker, fire control and all-up rounds for Shahed-class targets. UM's seeker and fire-control work could fit a component topic in a future round. Watch the winners — they are the next LCI vendors.

title: Army Low-Cost Interceptor (LCI) program
agency: Army CPE/PAE Defensive Fires (BG Guy Yelverton); ASA(ALT)
type: Program (xTech white papers; 120-day development; live fire at White Sands, fall 2026)
fit_note: Targets jet Shahed-class, cruise missiles and SRBMs — larger than UM's Block 1. Open architecture and government-owned IP; component on-ramps continue.

title: Next Generation C-sUAS Missile (NGCM) RFI
amount: <$150K per missile; min 5,000; 50 for operational assessment by Q1 FY28
fit_note: Coyote-launcher-compatible missile for Group 2-3 out to 16-25 km — a missile, not a recoverable interceptor. Useful for pricing context.

title: JIATF-401 C-UAS Marketplace IDIQ — remaining ceiling to $7B
deadline: Additional awards expected by end of Oct 2026
amount: ~$1.85B of $7B ceiling not yet placed (as of 2026-09-29)
fit_note: The main domestic C-UAS buying vehicle. If this round closes without UM, the target is the next on-ramp and subcontracting to an awardee (e.g. Digital Force Technologies, Napatree, SRC) as their interceptor or effector.

title: FEMA C-UAS Grant Program — FY2027 tranche
type: Grant to states & territories (vendor sells to grantees)
fit_note: SLTT agencies can buy only federally authorized tech; a non-kinetic capture effector is the type of mitigation most likely to be accepted over populated areas. Needs the DOJ/DHS authorized-technology listing.

title: DIU: Counter-UAS Sensing for Homeland and Mobile Defense (CSO)
type: Commercial Solutions Opening (OT prototype; production follow-on under 10 USC 4022(f))
fit_note: Shows DIU's homeland-defense focus; watch for a follow-on defeat/interceptor CSO. DIU's Counter NEXT already prototypes Group 3+ interceptors (Anduril, Zone 5).
